title: EVA-01 · Hawksbill Gap
subtitle: Fan-front sedimentary outcrops, Jezero Crater
scenario_note: Hypothetical crewed Marswalk. Stations, routes and timings are ours; every place, image and measurement shown comes from NASA mission data.

science_objective.text: Characterise the layered sedimentary rock at the front of Jezero's fan and choose two sampling locations, revisiting the outcrops Perseverance cored in July–August 2022.
basis: Mars 2020 sampling record: Skinner Ridge (Swift Run + Skyland) and Wildcat Ridge (Hazeltop + Bearwallow), rock type 'Sedimentary', location 'Fan Front'.

timeline_basis.text: Task structure and planned durations follow the representative BASALT-2 planned EVA timeline (three stations, then presampling survey, then two sampling tasks).

assumptions.note: Our own planning assumptions, not NASA limits. Ground Perseverance drove over is preferred because a rover has already crossed it; that is evidence about the surface, not a human-rating.

stations.name: Three Forks
stations.note: Hypothetical egress point on level crater floor, at Three Forks where Perseverance laid out its sample depot. The rover was parked here on sols 686–693.

stations.name: Rose River Falls
stations.note: Foot of the climb through Hawksbill Gap onto the fan front. Perseverance was here on sols 449–454.

checks: Follow the planned route; stay off red slope cells

Describe the outcrop belt ahead, left to right
Mark layered outcrops visible upslope
Confirm line of sight to Station B
Climb via the mapped gap; slope rises above 15° near the top
Stop below the ledge
Describe layering and grain size of the ledge
Photograph the outcrop face
Locate the 2022 core site on the ledge
Flag one fresh candidate nearby
Short traverse along the bench, about 20 m
Keep the ledge on your right
Describe the low, light-toned slab
Compare with Skinner Ridge
Locate the 2022 core site on the slab
Flag one fresh candidate nearby
Document each candidate at B and C
Agree sampling priority with the science team
Sample the agreed Skinner Ridge candidate
Record position and orientation
Sample the agreed Wildcat Ridge candidate
Record position and orientation
Descend by the planned route
Confirm samples stowed before ingress
